name: s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::?/* (leading single-char wildcard bucket head) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn regression (iter2): a bare leading '?' on the S3 bucket-name head matches any single leading character, so the matched bucket set is unbounded from its head (nearly-all buckets) - not a concrete named bucket. A trailing '/*' then reaches every object. isBroadArnResource() tested only startsWith('*'), so the '?'-led head escaped every branch and this returned CLEAN (DATA-EXFIL fail-open, T8). Fail CLOSED: a leading '?' head is broad. DATA-EXFIL must fire at high; CLI must exit non-zero.
